evidence.quoted_text:
* Snapshot of the validated events this writer accepted. Durable in both
   * modes; without a journalDir this is the ONLY copy (persistence
   * unavailable), so T30/T31 can build report rows from it.
evidence.reason: The doc comment on events() is internally contradictory: line 102 asserts the snapshot is "Durable in both" modes, while lines 103–104 state that without a journalDir it is the ONLY copy and persistence is unavailable. The surrounding contract in the same interface confirms persistence is 'unavailable' memory-only (line 94) and the function doc says memory-only keeps events in memory only (line 135). The same paragraph is the documented basis for T30/T31 report rows, so the false durability claim is a genuine doc/API-surface defect rather than a request to enlarge scope. (The file-header and accepted-event durability lines cited by the finding are outside the supplied region, but the contradiction is verifiable from the region itself.)
